Ava (People Ops): Quick sync — planning Q2 recognition redemptions. Need to finalize vendor, deadline, and manager guidance doc. TL;DR: digital gift cards + charity option, physical swag for US only. Who can advise on tax/reporting for EU/APAC? :raised_hands:
Samir Ahmed: We've used TangoCard and Rybbon in the past. Tango had better global coverage. EU VAT/tax was a pain.
Jordan Lee: For Ireland/UK we treat small non-cash gifts under €50 as non-taxable if infrequent. Need to confirm for DE/FR.
Marta Gonzalez: In Spain HR asked for payslip reporting if value > 150 EUR. I'll confirm with legal.
Kai Chen: APAC note — in SG and HK, token/card redemption might trigger payroll/benefits reporting. Recommend offering a cash-equivalent donation instead to avoid payroll.
Lily O'Connor: Vendor RFP? Also confirm KYC for recipients in CN. 
Ava (People Ops): Good points. Can we agree to: 1) primary vendor TangoCard, fallback Rybbon; 2) cap per-person at $75 USD equivalent; 3) charity donation opt-in; 4) manager email template + ledger csv.
Samir Ahmed: +1 on TangoCard. Also request their EU tax docs/POA now.
Jordan Lee: Can draft manager email. I'll add sections: 'what to tell nominees', 'how to submit receipts if required'.
Marta Gonzalez: Legal says need vendor MOAs and country-by-country guidance before sending. I'll aim to have a short doc by Wed.
Kai Chen: Scheduling a 30-min manager Q&A would help. My avail: Tue/Thu mornings. 
Ava (People Ops): Let's do Tue 10am PT / Wed 6am AEST — that'll cover NA/APAC. I'll send calendar invites. 
Lily O'Connor: CSV header for ledger please — helps finance import. Suggest: `employee_email,recipient_country,award_amount_usd,award_type,redemption_method,notes`
Ava (People Ops): Great — using that. Draft manager email below:
```
Hi team,
We're running the Q2 Recognition program. If your teammate is selected, submit their name + email here by MM/DD. Awards are digital gift cards (up to $75 USD) or optional charity donation. See attached country guidance. Managers: please don't promise cash; use the official email.
Thanks,
Ava
```
Jordan Lee: Small edit: add line about tax withholding in specific countries and link to guidance doc.
Ava (People Ops): Will add. Next steps: Marta to confirm legal guidance by Wed, Samir to request vendor docs by EOD, Jordan to finish manager email, Kai to host Q&A. PeopleOps Bot: reminder scheduled — send manager invites once docs are ready. :robot_face:
Marta Gonzalez: Got it. I'll ping legal today. 
Samir Ahmed: Filed vendor request (`vendor-request-2026-05-04`) — pinged Tango rep.
Jordan Lee: Draft email in /docs/people-ops/q2-recognition/manager-email-v1.md — feedback welcome.
Ava (People Ops): Thanks team. If no objections I'll lock vendor Friday and open nominations next Monday. :calendar:
Lily O'Connor: :thumbsup:
Kai Chen: :+1:
PeopleOps Bot: calendar invite created for Tue 1768456000 (Q&A: Q2 Recognition Tax + Redemption) — attendees: Ava (People Ops), Kai Chen, Jordan Lee, Marta Gonzalez, Samir Ahmed
